column1: # Config-gated runtime patches for Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA MegaMix
# Format: flag \t offset(0x..) \t new bytes (hex) \t reason
# Config flags are read from the DM_CONFIG env var: "ExPatch=1,noMV=0,..."
# An unset or 0 flag means the patch is not applied.
# Offsets are module-relative virtual addresses from exlaunch's patches.hpp
# (post-FIX = addr - 0x100 where FIX applies). Original bytes are asserted at
# runtime — if they don't match, the patch is still written (the loader trusts
# the config author to match the actual build).
# ExPatch: unlock all difficulty levels  (exlaunch: if Config::ExPatch)
# Remove Copyright & PV watermark  (exlaunch: if Config::removeWatermarks)
# Skip SEGA logos / intros (TaskAdvLogo)  (exlaunch: if Config::skipAdv)
# TODO: can be a CUT at 0x00077AC0 (mov w0, #1; ret). Verified offset needed.
# Movie_pv_type to not be FRONT for all vids  (exlaunch: if Config::backMV)
# The inline hook at 0x004CADF8 cannot be an OBS gate (not at function entry,
# not after bl, scratch_dead fails). Needs a host-side runtime approach.
# Converted from exlaunch Write calls (config-gated runtime patches)
